title: APGI Framework: Allostatic Precision-Gated Ignition for Consciousness Research (v1.1.0)
description: Companion code and synthetic seed datasets for the APGI paper series (Papers 1–3). Implements core APGI equations (Sₜ, θₜ, Πⁱ_eff), a Liquid Neural Network extension (Paper 2), a five-level hierarchical architecture (Paper 3), parameter recovery, clinical DoC interpretation, and all figure-generation scripts. Includes nine pre-generated synthetic datasets (sim0–sim8) covering HEP proxy validation, ignition dynamics, parameter recovery, LNN reservoir trajectories, hierarchical prediction-error series, disorder-of-consciousness biomarkers, LNN bifurcation signatures, the metabolic crossover and the causal TMS design; data/seeds/seed_manifest.json records each file's SHA-256, seed and alignment with protocol specification v1.1.0.
notes: To reproduce all figures: bash reproduce_all.sh. To regenerate seed datasets: python data/generate_seeds.py (uses MASTER_SEED=2025 for all archived sim0–sim8 datasets; python data/generate_seeds.py --verify checks them against data/checksums.sha256). Individual figure-generation scripts (figures/generate_figure*.py) each use their own fixed, documented seed and do not share MASTER_SEED. ORCID (0009-0005-0328-2896), OSF project (https://osf.io/t5hcq) and code repository (https://github.com/apgiframework/apgi-framework) confirmed.
